gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically proven glioblastoma multiforme wild type for IDH1-2 mutation

candidate_evidence.quote: a pilot prospective interventional clinical trial using a novel 18F-GE-180 PET radio-metabolic marker (AxMP) and MRI with advanced sequences with no modification of standard of care treatment

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Before surgery and starting the standard treatment with RT and chemotherapy, all subjects will undergo baseline MRI and 18F-GE-180 PET imaging

role_evidence.quote: PET examination of glioblastoma using 18F-GE-180 PET radio-metabolic marker
standard treatment with radiotherapy and chemotherapy
Patient eligible to undergo treatment with TMZ and RT (Stupp protocol or hypofractionated protocol as per Institutional Multidisciplinary Brain Tumor Board's decision)

source_quote.quote: Histologically proven glioblastoma multiforme wild type for IDH1-2 mutation
with MGMT promoter methylated or unmethylated

coder_notes: Diagnostic/biomarker study, no antitumour candidate. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but all patients receive standard Stupp/hypofractionated treatment per physician; listed as soc_backbone. MGMT is mentioned only as 'methylated or unmethylated' (not an entry requirement); coded as exploratory.
